sections.verbatim_opening: The Staffordshire Bull Terrier is, by nature, a robust and resilient breed known for its vitality and affectionate spirit. However, like all breeds, they can be predisposed to certain hereditary health conditions. A reputable blue staffy breeder will be fully transparent about these issues and actively work to minimise their occurrence through careful breeding and inbreeding coefficient (COI) for staffies.
